name: lynxship
description: A small, testable LynxJS build, submit and OTA control plane.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @lynxship/asset-pipeline build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/lynx-library-tools build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/test-kit build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/i18n build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/permissions build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/router build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/device-storage build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/observability build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/ui-tokens build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/tailwind-lynx build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/lynxtron build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/media build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/microhs build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/lynx-realtime build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/notifications build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/expo build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/worker-android build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/worker-ios build && pnpm --filter @lynxship/cli build && pnpm --filter create-lynxship-app build && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/core.test.ts test/api.test.ts test/cli.test.ts test/cli-ui.test.ts test/create-app.test.ts test/plugins.test.ts test/microhs.test.ts test/expo.test.ts test/realtime.test.ts test/notifications.test.ts test/lynx-library-tools.test.ts test/asset-pipeline.test.ts test/native-packages.test.ts test/test-kit.test.ts test/i18n.test.ts test/i18next.test.ts test/intl.test.ts test/permissions.test.ts test/router.test.ts test/device-storage.test.ts test/observability.test.ts test/ui-tokens.test.ts test/tailwind-lynx.test.ts test/lynxtron.test.ts test/media.test.ts test/workers.test.ts test/db.test.ts test/build-providers.test.ts
scripts.lint: pnpm architecture:check && pnpm structure:check && tsx scripts/lint.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @lynxship/dashboard build && tsx scripts/verify-release.ts
